candidates.change_summary: Replace the balance accumulation with a plain assignment so prior deposits are overwritten.
Deposit double the sent value into the sender's balance.
Always set unlockTime to _unlockTime, dropping the clamp to block.timestamp.
Delete the assignment that updates acc.unlockTime so it retains its previous value.
Delete the LogFile.AddMessage call so deposits are no longer recorded in the log's History/LastMsg.
Remove the statement that sets locked_ = true, so the mutex is never engaged and reentrancy into Collect becomes possible.
Remove the statement that resets locked_ to false after the function body, so the lock stays engaged forever and any subsequent Put/Collect call reverts.
Remove the balance-decrement statement so the sender's stored balance is not reduced after a successful payout.
Remove the log-message statement so a successful Collect is not recorded in the Log contract's History.
